destinations.name: Bodh Gaya
destinations.shortDescription: The supreme spiritual cradle where Prince Siddhartha attained Enlightenment beneath the sacred Bodhi Tree in 528 BCE. Home to the UNESCO World Heritage Mahabodhi Temple.
destinations.overview: The supreme spiritual cradle where Prince Siddhartha attained Enlightenment beneath the sacred Bodhi Tree in 528 BCE. Home to the UNESCO World Heritage Mahabodhi Temple.
destinations.fullDescription: The supreme spiritual cradle where Prince Siddhartha attained Enlightenment beneath the sacred Bodhi Tree in 528 BCE. Home to the UNESCO World Heritage Mahabodhi Temple.

destinations.name: Nalanda
destinations.shortDescription: The ancient world’s legendary residential university that flourished for 700 years. Vast red brick ruins, monumental votive stupas, and lecture halls.
destinations.overview: Ancient seat of international higher learning where 10,000 scholars and 2,000 acharyas debated philosophy, astronomy, and science. UNESCO World Heritage Site.

destinations.name: Rajgir
destinations.shortDescription: Ancient Magadhan capital cradled in seven hills. Site of Lord Buddha’s Vulture Peak teachings, sacred hot springs, and the dazzling white Vishwa Shanti Stupa.
destinations.overview: First imperial capital of Magadha. Notable for the aerial chairlift ropeway, Peace Pagoda, Ghora Katora Lake, and Gridhrakuta.

destinations.name: Patna
destinations.shortDescription: Historic Pataliputra, imperial capital of Mauryan & Gupta empires along the sacred Ganges. Home to the modern Bihar Museum and Takht Sri Patna Sahib.
destinations.overview: Millennia-old capital featuring the world-class Bihar Museum, Golghar granary, sacred Takht Sri Patna Sahib, and evening Ganga Aarti.

destinations.name: Vaishali
destinations.shortDescription: The world’s first recorded democratic republic. Sacred birthplace of Lord Mahavira and location of Emperor Ashoka’s polished sandstone lion pillar.
destinations.overview: Capital of the ancient Licchavi republic, site of Buddha’s Last Sermon, Relic Stupa, and Ashokan Lion Pillar.

destinations.name: Valmiki Tiger Reserve
destinations.shortDescription: Lush Himalayan foothills and moist Sal forests along the Gandak River. Bihar’s premier eco-tourism sanctuary home to Bengal tigers, rhinos, and hornbills.
destinations.overview: Over 898 sq km of pristine wilderness in the Terai region. Jungle jeep safaris, river rafting, and canopy lodges.
